groups.name: beacon
groups.description: Beacon SDK configuration — 13 canonical surfaces. See docs/adr/0009 (anticipated) and beacon-s0-contract/spec/02-sdk-behavior-spec.md §4.

groups.name: beacon.redact
groups.description: Composite redact key (canonical surface 13). Nested: keys, defaults, timeout-ms.

properties.name: beacon.enabled
properties.description: Starter-only opt-out gate (NOT one of the 13 canonical keys). Set false to disable all Beacon wiring without removing the dependency. (Pitfall #18.)

properties.name: beacon.endpoint
properties.description: OTLP gRPC endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:4317. (Canonical key 1.)

properties.name: beacon.batch-max-records
properties.description: Max records per OTLP batch. (Canonical key 5.)

properties.name: beacon.max-retries
properties.description: Retry attempts on retriable OTLP failures. (Canonical key 7.)

properties.name: beacon.redact.keys
properties.description: User-configured PII keys to scrub. (Nested under canonical key 13 `redact`.)

properties.name: beacon.redact.defaults
properties.description: If true, union user keys with the always-on baseline password|authorization|api_key|secret|token. (Nested under canonical key 13 `redact`.)

properties.name: beacon.redact.timeout-ms
properties.description: Per-record redaction budget on the caller thread. (Nested under canonical key 13 `redact`; folded from M1.6's redactorTimeoutMs per ADR-0009 §3.)
